subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar adopt external local-command hooks and their documented event, configuration, and payload contract as a supported core feature?
rationale: The implementation is technically mature, but merging creates durable execution and compatibility surfaces that require repository-owner intent rather than an automated correctness decision.

options.title: Adopt the v1 contract
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass and treat the documented event names, config schema, payload fields, and execution semantics as supported compatibility surface.

options.title: Narrow before adoption
options.body: Reduce the initial events or payload fields, then explicitly freeze and test the smaller supported contract.

options.title: Decline core hooks
options.body: Close the PR if CodexBar should remain observability-only without launching user-configured commands.

recommendation.title: Adopt the v1 contract
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks pass and treat the documented event names, config schema, payload fields, and execution semantics as supported compatibility surface.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and author of the latest branch hardening commits, steipete is the clearest owner of this product-boundary decision.
